origins: Exactly the existing accepted train/val sample origins; no new interaction gate or split boundaries
context: Every non-guard vehicle with 20 complete historical states; future availability is not consulted
targets: Every history-eligible vehicle with 20 complete future labels inside the same inherited split
neighborhood: For each target independently: center in slot0 plus up to 7 neighbors by original active-edge/DCPA/closing/distance/ID ordering
selection_input: GT final historical [x,y,vx,vy]; source smoothing and full-track quality filter inherited, online causality unproven
input: Reused frozen 0 dB states plus deterministic same-protocol missing-key sensing
supervision: target_mask slot0 only; vehicle_mask describes available context
storage: Shared unique sensed state pool, shared context-history indices, target-specific patch indices and future GT indices
metric_primary: Mean within each origin over unique targets, then mean over origins
